xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnFinancialRe:
1. The standalone financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026 were reviewed by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board on 13 November 2026. The Statutory Auditors have reviewed these results and issued an unmodified review report.

2. During the quarter ended 30 September 2026, the Company has issued 9,450 equity shares of face value of Rs. 1 each to the eligible employees on exercise of employee stock options.

3. During the quarter, the Company along with other Group companies has completed the strategic sale of Nido Home Finance Limited ("Nido") to an investor, resulting in Nido ceasing to be a subsidiary with effect from 25 September 2026. The transaction has no material impact on the Company's standalone financial results for the quarter ended 30 September 2026.

4. Employee benefits expense includes variable pay and a one-time employee incentive expense of Rs. 12 crores and Rs. 33.50 crores for quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026 respectively.

5. During the previous quarter ended 30 June 2026, the Company had recognized dividend income of Rs. 83.86 crores on receipt of Bonus Redeemable Preference ('RPS') Shares allotted by Edelweiss Asset Reconstruction Company Limited to its existing shareholders. Pursuant to Ind AS 109, the Bonus RPS have been recognized as a financial asset at face value with a corresponding credit to dividend income.

Standalone segment results for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026

The Company is engaged primarily in the business of merchant banking and holding company activities such as capital allocation and managerial oversight to the business of subsidiaries and investment activities and accordingly there are no separate reportable segments as per Ind AS 108 dealing with Operating Segments.

1 Net figures have been reported on account of volume of transactions.

Cash Flow Statement has been prepared under the indirect method as set out in Ind AS 7 prescribed under the Companies (Indian Accounting Standard) Rules, 2015 under the Companies Act, 2013.

Figures for the previous period/year have been regrouped/reclassified wherever necessary to conform to current period/year presentation.
